notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content: [p]Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Small terrain tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]Shifted positions of some items[/p][/*][*][p]Slight visual changes in the Amber Shore[/p][/*][*][p]Small balance tweaks[/p][/*][*][p]The game now automatically saves when starting a battle[/p][/*][/list][p]Bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain upgrades caused the game to freeze momentarily and then cause the player to be unable to build anything[/p][list][*][p]Also disabled those upgrades as they should not have been unlocked at this stage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would be unable to enter other areas if their FPS exceeded 100[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player sometimes respawned out of bounds[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]
